title: Driver Compensation Schedule: Lost Driving Time on Cleaning and Damage Fees Repair Charges
content:
**Rule.** The lost driving time of a Cleaning and Damage Fees damage fee approved at review depends on the level held and the reported trip's ride option: an exterior repair on Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV, whose vehicle stays off premium service until the panel and calibration work is booked, takes the daily damage lost-time rate for each calendar day from the reported trip's drop-off date through the date of the latest repair estimate or receipt on the assessment's evidence ledger (the report date when none is on the ledger), both days counted; an exterior repair on any other ride option takes the daily damage lost-time rate for one day; an interior repair, which leaves the vehicle drivable, takes no lost driving time.

The daily damage lost-time rate is $55.00. The lost driving time is added to the amount the damage fee charged on approval is based on, before the fee is held to its ceiling.

| Level held | Ride option on the trip record | Lost driving time |
|---|---|---|
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV | $55.00 for each calendar day from the drop-off date through the latest repair estimate or receipt date (or the report date), both counted |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | any other ride option | $55.00, one day |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | any | none |

- **Drop-off date** and **ride option**: from the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).
- **Latest repair estimate or receipt**: the latest repair estimate or repair receipt submission on the assessment's evidence ledger, by its date.
- **Report date**: the date of the moment the report was registered, used when no repair estimate or receipt is on the ledger.

## Day counts (hypothetical, exterior repair on a Wayfare Black SUV trip that dropped off on 2 September)

| Latest repair document on the ledger | Days counted | Lost driving time |
|---|---|---|
| repair estimate dated 5 September | 4 | $220.00 |
| repair receipt dated 2 September | 1 | $55.00 |
| none; report registered on 3 September | 2 | $110.00 |

The same exterior repair on a Wayfare Comfort trip takes $55.00 whatever the dates.
